name: Aoi
source:
Aoi is a sexually anxious middle-aged woman who is also the main antagonist of the story. She is a criminal who has been hunted by Emanon's agents for a long time. She has many henchmen. Her main goal is to kidnap [url=/c575]Riri[/url] and become the head of the criminal world.

[Translated from [url=http://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/Noel]the Russian Wikipedia[/url].]
